en: Illustrated postcard showing a sunlit town square with a large baroque fountain at its center, decorated with multiple statues and set on several circular steps. Behind it stand painted façades with arcades and many shuttered windows, a tall tree, and distant mountains. A few birds peck on the ground and a cloaked figure walks near the fountain. A handwritten message in Italian runs vertically along the right margin.
